The '''Lawreys system''',<ref name="CP" /> also referred to as the '''Sinkar system'''<ref name="TEA-OC" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located on the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sinkar]].<ref name="CP" />
